name: Rook product brief review
cadence: Mondays at 08:00 in the application's local schedule
timezone_note: The current chat uses America/Chicago. The automation API accepted the local weekly recurrence and returned ACTIVE, but its model-readable response does not expose an independent timezone or next-run timestamp. An explicit timezone argument and a timezone-anchored event format were unsupported; the valid local recurrence was restored and confirmed ACTIVE.
user_visible_output: Meaningful issue changes, source removals and new access failures/recovery; unchanged successful runs stay quiet.
runtime_dependency: For local-folder work, keep the computer on, app running, repo available, and Rook wiki connection accessible.
verification: App create and update responses reported the same automation ID with status ACTIVE. The view tool rendered a user-visible automation card; no expanded MCP App was available for model-side DOM inspection.
assignment_requirement: Skill executed twice manually and registered on a schedule. A future weekly trigger is not stated as a pre-submission requirement.
